messages.author: b528d7215bb7e7e5
messages.subject: why not work when I use runModels
parts:
I wanted to run path analysis in Mplus, so I used the runModels in the R, and the R showed the warning message as follows, and did not continue to run.

quote: '"Mplus"' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.


Thanks,

Liang

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: why not work when I use runModels
parts:
Hi Liang,

Please look at the Mplus_command argument of runModels if you have installed Mplus to a non-standard location. As for direct, indirect, and total, look at $indirect field from readModels.

Best,
Michael
